source.title: Pre-Technical Studies Grade 9 - July 2024 - Revised (KICD Junior School Curriculum Design)
source.notes: WebFetch could not summarize the PDF ('unable to extract text') but saved it locally; the Read tool then parsed the full PDF text natively, verbatim, page by page. Cover page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT / JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN / PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES / GRADE 9', ISBN 978-9914-43-985-4, first published 2024 — this matches the confirmed official filename 'Pre-Technical Studies Grade 9 - July 2024 - Revised.pdf' from KICD's own Google Drive index. All 5 strands and 13 sub-strands below were read verbatim from the 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS' table (p.xii) and cross-checked against each strand's own detailed section (pp.1-31), not summarized or paraphrased. The document breaks down no further than sub-strand level (no subSubStrands anywhere) — every sub-strand's Specific Learning Outcomes table is the finest granularity in the design. This is the same document a prior session used to derive the app's existing 5-strand list in web/src/lib/curriculum.ts; re-verification here confirms that strand list is complete, but the app currently only has 2 skills per strand (10 total) against 13 official sub-strands, so several sub-strands (e.g. 1.3 Self-Exploration and Career Development, 2.2 Visual Programming, 4.3 Project, 5.2 Government and Business, 5.3 Business Plan) likely have zero dedicated skills yet.

subStrands.name: Safety on Raised Platforms
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks
Describe risks associated with working on raised platforms
Observe safety when working on raised platforms
Appreciate the need for observing safety while working on raised platforms
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the importance of observing safety when working on raised platforms?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 8 lessons. Example raised platform types named in the design: ladders, trestles, steps, stands, mobile raised platforms, work benches, ramps.

subStrands.name: Handling Hazardous Substances
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify hazardous substances found in the environment
Classify hazardous substances found in the locality
Describe safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment
Handle hazardous substances safely in the environment
Appreciate the importance of observing safety when handling hazardous substances
subStrands.notes: Suggested 9 lessons. Hazardous substance categories named in the design: poisonous, flammable, corrosive.

subStrands.name: Self-Exploration and Career Development
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain ways of nurturing talents and abilities for self-development
Relate talents and abilities to career pathways
Analyse ethical and unethical practices related to the use of talents and abilities
Choose a career based on talents and abilities for self-development
keyInquiryQuestions: How are talents and abilities nurtured?
Why is self-exploration necessary for career development?

subStrands.name: Oblique Projection
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the characteristics of oblique drawing in technical fields
Sketch given drawings in oblique projection
Draw shaped blocks in oblique projection
Appreciate the application of oblique projection in drawing
keyInquiryQuestions: How are oblique drawings used in technical fields?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 14 lessons. Design specifies both cavalier and cabinet oblique projection methods, the latter using geometrical set drawing instruments.

subStrands.name: Visual Programming
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the application areas of visual programming software in solving problems
Create an application using visual programming software for solving problems in day-to-day life
Embrace the use of visual programming in the day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How are applications developed using visual programming software?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 15 lessons. Design suggests building games, stories and animations using visual programming software.

subStrands.name: Wood
specificLearningOutcomes: Classify wood according to physical characteristics
Describe the preparation of wood for use in the production of items
Relate types of wood to their uses in the community
Value the importance of wood in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is wood important in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 8 lessons. Covers softwood vs hardwood classification and wood preparation methods (conversion and seasoning).

subStrands.name: Handling Waste Materials
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify waste materials found in the environment
Describe ways of handling waste materials safely in the environment
Dispose waste materials using appropriate methods
Appreciate the need for proper handling of waste materials in the environment
keyInquiryQuestions: How are waste materials handled in the locality?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 8 lessons. Waste categories named: plastic, glass, metal, wood waste, electronic waste, construction waste. Disposal methods named: reduce, reuse, recycle, compost, burn.

subStrands.name: Holding Tools
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify holding tools used in day-to-day life
Select holding tools for performing given tasks
Use holding tools to perform given tasks
Care for holding tools used in day-to-day life
Appreciate the importance of holding tools in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How are holding tools used in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 8 lessons. Example holding tools named: pliers, clamps, tongs, clips, vice.

subStrands.name: Driving Tools
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify driving tools used in day-to-day life
Select driving tools for performing given tasks
Use driving tools to perform given tasks
Care for driving tools used in day-to-day life
Acknowledge the importance of driving tools in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How are driving tools used in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 8 lessons. Example driving tools named: hammer, screwdriver, spanner, punches, mallets.

subStrands.name: Project
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify a problem in the locality that can be solved using the skills acquired in Pre-Technical Studies
Select an item that can be made to solve the identified problem
Make an item to solve the problem identified using locally available materials
Utilise skills acquired in Pre-Technical Studies to solve problems in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How are skills acquired in Pre-Technical Studies used to solve problems in the community?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 20 lessons — the largest single sub-strand in the whole design. This is a hands-on, learner-driven making/build project (identify a local problem, sketch, cost, build, price, present an item using locally available materials). Needs an explicit build/product-design decision for the app since it isn't naturally a multiple-choice/short-answer quiz skill the way the others are; do not silently drop it.

subStrands.name: Financial Services
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify financial institutions available in Kenya
Classify financial institutions in Kenya
Analyse services offered by financial institutions in Kenya
Utilise financial services for entrepreneurial development
keyInquiryQuestions: What services are offered by different financial institutions in Kenya?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 4 lessons. Institution types named: banks, insurance, SACCOs, micro finance.

subStrands.name: Government and Business
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the reasons for government involvement in business
Describe ways of government involvement in business
Explore types of taxes in Kenya
Analyse e-Government services in business
Acknowledge the need to comply with Government regulations in business
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important for the Government to get involved in business?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 6 lessons. Tax types named: income tax, VAT, corporate tax, fuel levy, excise duty. e-Government example cited: NTSA motor vehicle business registration and licensing.

subStrands.name: Business Plan
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the importance of a business plan in entrepreneurship
Describe the components of a business plan in financial management
Fill in a business plan template for a given business project
Embrace the use of a business plan in entrepreneurship
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is a business plan important to an entrepreneur?
How is a business plan prepared?
subStrands.notes: Suggested 6 lessons. Business plan components named: executive summary, business description, market/competitor analysis, product and services, marketing plan, financial projection.
